mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has improved monotonically across the four weekly means (-46.0, -44.4, -41.1, -40.6), a persistent reopening drift of roughly +1.8 points per week. That drift continues, so the mean over the next 28 days exceeds the last-28-day mean of about -43.0.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC weekly means -46.0, -44.4, -41.1, -40.6 rise monotonically from t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: The mean of RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is less than or equal to its mean over the last 28 days (approximately -43.0).

mechanism_narrative: Households are reallocating time out of the home and out of outdoor venues into commercial venues: RESIDENTIAL has fallen 2.1 points over four weeks while PARKS dropped 21.7 points in the latest week. When both substitutions occur jointly, indoor retail and recreation absorbs the displaced hours over the following two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls at least 15 points week-on-week while RESIDENTIAL is down at least 2 points over four weeks
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS fell from 49.0 at t-1w to 27.3 at t-0w while RESIDENTIAL fell from 15.1 at t-3w to 13.0 at t-0w
failure_condition: When PARKS drops at least 15 points week-on-week and RESIDENTIAL is down at least 2 points over four weeks, the mean of RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is not above its preceding 14-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT has been pinned between -55.6 and -53.3 for four weeks. A break above -50.0, a 3.7-point improvement from the t-0w value of -53.7, signals restored discretionary transit travel, which converts into retail and recreation footfall within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean rises above -50.0 from the t-0w level of -53.7
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT flat between -55.6 and -53.3 across t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: After TRANSIT crosses above -50.0, the mean of RETAIL_REC over the following 14 days is lower than its mean over the preceding 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES has been pinned within 0.2 points of -46.0 for four weeks, evidence of a durable remote-work policy regime. With office footfall frozen and PARKS rolling over from 49.0 to 27.3, both channels feeding discretionary daytime retail demand are exhausted, so RETAIL_REC gives back its climb over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES stays within the band [-47.0, -45.0] for four consecutive weekly means
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES means -45.9, -46.1, -46.0, -46.1 with PARKS falling 21.7 points at t-0w
regime_hint: prolonged remote-work regime with office mobility pinned near -46
failure_condition: While WORKPLACES remains within 1 point of -46.0, the mean of RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days exceeds its last-28-day mean of approximately -43.0.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS at +27 to +49 above baseline marks a late-summer outdoor-activity peak that is already unwinding, with the weekly mean dropping 21.7 points at t-0w. As outdoor crowding normalizes into September, displaced leisure hours shift indoors and raise RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS t-0w equals 27.3 versus 49.0 at t-1w, still far above the pre-period baseline
failure_condition: PARKS holds above +40 for the next four weekly means and the next-28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is not above its last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM has deteriorated steadily (-19.1 to -20.4) and now sits below -20 for the first time in the window, showing that provisioning and stockpiling trips have stopped absorbing household trip budget. Freed trips are redirected to discretionary retail, lifting RETAIL_REC within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM weekly mean falls below -20.0, as at t-0w with -20.4
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM moves -19.1, -18.3, -19.4, -20.4 and crosses below -20 at t-0w
failure_condition: In the 14 days after GROCERY_PHARM sits below -20.0, the mean of RETAIL_REC is lower than its mean over the preceding 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL remains elevated at +13.0 while TRANSIT is suppressed at -53.7. Retail footfall gains require time at home to fall and transit trips to rise together; with transit frozen, each further decline in RESIDENTIAL yields only a small retail gain, so the one-week-ahead direction is weakly positive.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL weekly mean declines by at least 0.5 points from t-0w while TRANSIT remains below -50.0
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL drifts 15.1 to 13.0 while TRANSIT stays stuck between -55.6 and -53.3
failure_condition: When RESIDENTIAL falls at least 0.5 points week-on-week with TRANSIT below -50.0, RETAIL_REC in the next 7 days is flat or lower in the majority of observations.

Outdoor activity is no longer the substitute for indoor leisure, and the substitution reversal should be visible within one week, lifting the next-7-day RETAIL_REC mean above the prior 7-day mean.
candidate_trigger: PARKS week-on-week change is at most -15 points
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS moved 49.0 to 27.3 while RETAIL_REC moved -41.1 to -40.6 over the same week
